policy: Exclude from every comparative quality statistic; retain frozen input, all outputs and original preliminary ratings. Do not replace the passage or rerun models. Performance statistics retain the original complete sequences.

excludedCases.reason: The intended classic visiting-relatives ambiguity was compromised by inserting the definite article in the visiting relatives. The ordinary visitors reading cannot fairly be counted as a serious error. The+VPing constructions have special discourse/grammatical properties, so this is not a clean binary ambiguity test.
excludedCases.consequence: 31 of 32 main passages scored; 8 of 9 new difficult cases scored; 15 of 16 paired-quantization cases scored. Original gate and hashes retained. Even granting full credit on this case gives Gemma 4 short only 27/32, below the frozen 30/32 gate.
